params.name: Run
params.tooltip: DEV ONLY. On (default): on each game load, lays out Better Roundabouts combinations and, in Build mode, BUILDS them at once. Only enable this mod on a throwaway Blank Slate map.

params.name: Mode
params.tooltip: Build (default): builds every placement the engine accepts (real roads in this save). Dry run: only logs the layout and an ASCII preview ([SQRB-SHOW] lines in stdout.txt).

params.name: Start delay
params.tooltip: Seconds after the game has loaded before the run starts

params.name: In flight
params.tooltip: Most builds waiting for the engine at once. Pieces closer than 50 m to a build still in flight wait for it, so neighbours are always checked against what is already built. 1 = strictly one after another.

params.name: Constructions
params.tooltip: Which Better Roundabouts entries to show

params.name: Combinations
params.tooltip: Showcase: every value of the most visible settings (scale, shape, layout, arms, lanes, island ...) plus scale x shape. Every: all combinations up to the cap (entries in turn). One at a time: each setting's values with the rest at default. Random: a seeded sample.

params.name: Cap
params.tooltip: With Fill = Repeat: the most constructions placed in total. With Fill = Off: the most distinct combinations (a kaleidoscope places 8 or 16 copies of each).

params.name: Pattern
params.tooltip: Grid: rows by entry and size. Mosaic: a quilt of blocks by island / lanes. Kaleidoscope 4 / 8: mirrored rings around the centre (traffic side flipped for true mirror images). Mandala: concentric rings. Spiral: golden-angle spiral by size. Size gradient: small to large along the diagonal. Checkerboard: two groups alternate. Scatter: seeded random.

params.name: Gap
params.tooltip: Free space between neighbouring constructions, on top of each street's own width and kerbs (and earth slopes of raised roads)

params.name: Rotation
params.tooltip: Pattern: each pattern's own (grids fixed, rings facing the centre, scatter random). Fixed: 0 degrees. Face centre. Random 90: multiples of 90. Random: any angle.

params.name: Position
params.tooltip: Layout centre: the X / Y settings, or the camera centre (the point the view looks at) when the run starts

params.name: Position X (m)
params.tooltip: World x of the layout centre (0 = map centre); Position = X / Y only

params.name: Position Y (m)
params.tooltip: World y of the layout centre (0 = map centre); Position = X / Y only

params.name: Max radius
params.tooltip: Nothing is placed further than this from the centre

params.name: Seed
params.tooltip: Random sample, random rotations and scatter positions (the same seed gives the same layout)

params.name: Fill
params.tooltip: Repeat to fill (default): when the combinations run out, place them again (same pattern order; whole orbits in a kaleidoscope) until the cap or the max radius is reached. Off: each combination once.
